trial.title: Yesani Premium kwaulere mukaifuna
trial.body: Nthawi yoyamba mukatsegula chinthu cha Premium, kuyesa kwaulere kumayamba: mlangizi wa AI, malangizo apamwamba, ndi AI yowerenga marisiti ndi ma SMS. Simufunika khadi kapena kulipira, ndipo palibe chimene chimapitirira chokha. Ikatha, zonse zomwe mwalemba zimakhalabe zaulere.

slide1.title: Onani komwe ndalama zanu zikupita

slide2.title: Zochitika zanu, zojambulidwa mwakhama
slide2.body: Uthenga wa ndalama ukafika, Mulinda imaulemba ndikukuuzani gulu lake. Dinani kuti mutsimikize ndipo imaphunzira. Jambulani risiti pa zomwe mwagula ndi ndalama za m'manja.

permissions.intro: Mulinda imapempha zilolezo zochepa kuti kusunga ndalama kukhale kosavuta. Chilichonse ndi chosankha - mutha kuyatsa tsopano kapena pambuyo pake mu Profile.
permissions.smsBody: Mukayatsa, Mulinda imawerenga ma SMS a ndalama ndi a banki (Airtel Money, TNM Mpamba, mabanki) ndikukonza zochitika kuti muwunike. Timangoyang'ana mauthenga okhala ndi zochitika za ndalama - mauthenga aumwini sawerengedwa kapena kusungidwa. Mutha kuzimitsa nthawi iliyonse.
permissions.cameraBody: Imagwiritsidwa ntchito mukajambula risiti kuti titulutse zochitika.
permissions.photosBody: Imalola kusankha chithunzi cha risiti kuchokera mu gallery kuti tisankhe.
permissions.notifBody: Zikumbutso za mabilu ndi ngongole, zikumbutso za kumapeto kwa tsiku, ndi zosintha za kulembetsa.
permissions.footer: Mumakhalabe ndi ulamuliro. Zilolezo zitha kusinthidwa nthawi iliyonse mu Profile, kapena mu zoikamo za foni yanu. Sitigulitsa deta yanu.
